name: luckylillia-plugin-ai-gateway
description: Lets other plugins call the AIs the user set up: ChatGPT, DeepSeek or any OpenAI-compatible API

description.zh: AI 网关：在这里添加 AI（接口地址、API Key、模型……），别的插件就能选用它们。支持 ChatGPT、DeepSeek 等所有 OpenAI 兼容的接口
description.en: AI gateway: set up AIs here (address, API key, model...) for other plugins to use. Any OpenAI-compatible API works, ChatGPT and DeepSeek included
